subject: [hw] DONE V02 rev 5 (commit 7c772e5; R1 F5/F7 fixed)
body:
Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v02/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V02 PASS 860/860
(ASan+UBSan -O1: 413/413, plain -O2: 413/413, TSan: 34/34.)

Since rev 4:
- R1 F5 fixed: n2a32_mem_create reserves 4 GiB + 64 KiB PROT_NONE, the extra page is a host-only guard (guest range, page table and all map/protect/mmio checks stay 4 GiB). A load/store crossing 0x1_0000_0000 now faults in the guard and becomes STOP_FAULT with stop_addr=0xFFFFFFFF instead of reading past the reservation; fault_handler accepts the guard range. n2a32_run also refuses a T32 32-bit fetch whose second halfword would cross 4 GiB (stop_addr=pc).
- R1 F7 fixed: n2a32_mem_mmio rejects addr=0.
- Tests: boundary T32 fetch at 0xFFFFFFFE, boundary LDR at 0xFFFFFFFE, in-range LDR at 0xFFFFFFFC, MMIO at 0; 860 checks total.

No other change. Still not compiled for arm64 iOS, not run on the phone, no performance numbers. Available for further findings.
